payload.text: Asahi's installer gives the new system macOS 14.8.3's OS firmware.

facts.name: authenticity
facts.value: HTTPS to updates.cdn-apple.com verified with the pinned runtime's CA bundle; URL pinned by Asahi v0.9.2; each member's zip CRC-32. No digest of Apple's bytes is checked.

payload.text: After the failure the disk's layout is unchanged (sha256:ece07dc6a3a8b0ee1c5d2ef8e6399fa00a7bebc6b34ae0de3b74303cb532b62a).
